text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Oka Sho, the first leg of the 
Triple Tiara. ...Yet it's a strange 
sensation. Was it truly my destiny to run 
in this race?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Let us see in this race whether 
I should pursue the mile route, or advance 
to the 2,400m Yushun Himba (Japanese 
Oaks)!
